captions.instagram:
A curved storage seat for a kitchen bay in Kennington.

The curve was drawn out full size on the board. Then curved frames cut to match, storage boxes built between them, a thin sheet bent round the front and panelled fronts fitted round the curve. Lift the lids for storage underneath.

There's a 3D model of it on my website: turn it round and lift the lids.
